steps.name: Bodyguard A
steps.text: Hoooooooot! I'm burning! I'm burning!

steps.name: Bodyguard B
steps.text: Eeek! My hair!

steps.name: Bodyguard A
steps.text: Tsk... Fall back, fall back!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hahaha! See, nothing's more fun than a good scrap, Doc!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Oh, that reminds me, Doc. Because I saved you, and didn't go overboard like you asked me to, you'd better not tell Silence about this!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: If she finds out about this, she's going to assign me more homework for sure!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hehe, I knew that you're a nice person, Doc!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hmph, you're on your own then!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: An Originium-powered flamethrower, with such power too... You must be a very skilled Caster.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: You're right on the money, Missy! I'm super powerful!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: My name is Ceylon.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Thank you for saving us.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Oh, um... it's my pleasure. I-I'm just doing the right thing.

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Hey Doc, this lady is really polite. What should I be doing now?

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Oh, um, I'll try it then...

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Ahh?! I forgot that I left meat on the grill! Gotta get going!

steps.name: Ifrit
steps.text: Doc, Ceylon, come find me afterwards if you want some barbecue!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Doctor, let's also hurry back.
Doctor, I'm glad you're fine.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Thank you very much, Mister...

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: You can call me Hellagur.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Just like the Doctor here, I'm also from Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Hellagur
steps.text: Doctor, do you have a minute? I need to have a few words with you, alone.
